description: The world model, pilot for ¶1–46: one fact per line. `of` an entity, `attr` the attribute, `value` an entity id or short text, `time` {at} or {from, to} (an open end: until further notice). `para`/`quote` where the story tells it. `basis`: stated (the default), implied (the text presupposes it) or inferable (`from` the facts it follows from; `inferable_at` the paragraph). `truth` from the answer key: true (the default), false, or null (the story never settles it). A `says` fact is true when it was said; what it says is a question's possibility (`q`, `pick`). `src`: the provenance chain from Watson outward ("watson" = he saw or heard it; "…" = links not yet filled in). `old`: the old game's claims or events it comes from. `given_at`: where the story gives it away, when later than ¶46.
